concept: Michelangelo's David: carving away everything that isn't the masterpiece

quote: Not everything you carry belongs to you. And not everything you lose is a loss.

voice_direction._status: ADVISORY -- for future assemble-audio.ts Stage 9 integration. Current pipeline uses per-segment elevenlabs_payload overrides.
voice_direction._law: Orator Law: silence is a first-class structural element. Narration conducts the visuals; it does not compete with them.
voice_direction.character: Documentary narrator. Not trailer narrator. Intimate, calm, observational. The doctrine is delivered as observation, not instruction.

breathing_points.after: You are building a cage out of certainty.
breathing_points.visual_state: Hook lands. The viewer is inside the cage before they know it. Give the line room.
Pivot diagnosis complete. The trap has been named. Viewer needs a beat before the doctrine arrives.

breathing_points.after: It rewards the capacity to bleed against the terrain.
breathing_points.visual_state: Central claim delivered. Terrain vs map. Let it sit before the directive begins.
Single-word directive. The shortest sentence in the script. It must not be rushed past.

voice_direction.fragmentation_directive: Resolution segment: 'Close the map. Enter the arena.' These are separate directives, not a flowing list. Each lands as a command. Hard stop between each.

sound_direction._status: v0.1-provisional -- 017-derived defaults. Override if this doctrine's emotional temperature requires it.

cinematic_layers.layer_1_philosophy: Voice. Documentary narrator. The doctrine is the intellectual foreground. Always forward.
cinematic_layers.layer_2_atmosphere: Music. Sub-bass industrial drone. Answers: what emotional temperature does this doctrine exist in? Answer: cold machinery. Not pressure. Not urgency. The machine that doesn't care.
cinematic_layers.layer_3_space: Silence. Between 'That is the trap.' and the pivot line, that silence is doing work. It is not empty.

dynamic_profile.relationship: Voice makes the accusation. Music confirms the cold.

dynamic_profile.music_directive: slow mechanical rise. Sub-bass tightens incrementally.
dynamic_profile.voice_directive: integrated. Accumulating rhythm mirrors the dopamine trap.
dynamic_profile.relationship: Music and voice accelerate together toward the trap's reveal.

dynamic_profile.music_directive: distortion surge at pivot onset, then duck to maximum clarity.
dynamic_profile.voice_directive: unchanged. Maximum clarity. This is the terrain line.
dynamic_profile.relationship: The surge marks the pivot. Then music recedes completely. Nothing competes with 'bleed against the terrain.'

dynamic_profile.music_directive: recover to reference level. Mechanical pulse returns.
dynamic_profile.voice_directive: directive mode. Each sentence a separate command.
dynamic_profile.relationship: Music confirms the directive is real. Not emotional. Operational.

dynamic_profile.music_directive: BPM-locked cut at loop seam. No fade, no decay.
dynamic_profile.relationship: Voice exits. Music cuts at seam. Silence holds for the loop.

silence_function.post_hook: Cage is built. Viewer hasn't yet realized they're inside it.
silence_function.post_trap: Trap named. Nothing more is said. The diagnosis is complete.
silence_function.post_directive: 'Move.' is a full stop. Not a transition.
silence_function.loop_seam: Grammatical and musical void. The loop resolves into 'You are not preparing.' which is not a resolution. It is a restart.

visual_prompt.primary_prompt: Restrained photorealistic 9:16 sequence in a monumental, nearly black sculpture gallery: one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), lit by a narrow ivory beam. Physically plausible fractures release heavy granite under real gravity, revealing intact charcoal clothing beneath. Antique-gold (#C6A94F) glints only inside fresh fractures; brief crimson (#DC143C) stress light precedes each break, never like blood or lava. The figure never becomes a gold statue. Ends with a fully clothed living person who looks into the lens and takes one step forward. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.
visual_prompt.runway_prompt_modifier: Hard-geometry CAD aesthetic. No organic morphing. Rigid wireframe transitions only.

global_visual_matrix.rendering_engine: Runway gen4.5. Hard-geometry CAD aesthetic, no organic drift.
anti_drift_rules: NO liquid, fluid, or organic morphing. Geometry must remain rigid.
NO floating particles or ambient debris unless specified.
NO lens flares unless tied to crimson interference event.
ALL transitions must be cut-hard or precision wipe. No dissolves.
Maintain 9:16 vertical framing at all times. No reframe.

chromatic_aberration.intensity: 4-5px RGB split on all crimson interference events; 1px baseline during gold telemetry sequences

motion_blur.intensity: moderate. 3-4px directional blur aligned to camera movement axis.

script.full_text: You were told to become more. More disciplined. More impressive. More complete. So you kept adding. Until you could no longer recognize what was underneath. But a sculptor does not add the figure to the stone. He removes what conceals it. The expectations. The performances. The identities you inherited without choosing. Not everything you carry belongs to you. And not everything you lose is a loss. Some things have to fall away before you can finally become...
script.mobius_note: Final segment stays open: 'can finally become...' resolves at loop restart with 'You were told to become more.'.

segments.text: You were told to become more. More disciplined. More impressive. More complete.
segments.visual_prompt: Absolute darkness, then a narrow shaft of ivory (#F5F2EB) light reveals one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), standing motionless in a monumental black gallery. Slow dolly forward. Three restrained impacts chip the forehead and cheek; a fleeting crimson (#DC143C) stress line precedes the last break and one living human eye appears, catching a muted antique-gold (#C6A94F) reflection. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

segments.text: So you kept adding. Until you could no longer recognize what was underneath. But a sculptor does not add the figure to the stone.
segments.visual_prompt: Intimate camera drift across heavy granite strata, scratches and mineral lines on one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A); the stone feels oppressive and the person beneath is hard to see. Then front-facing: most of the face still stone, one living eye looking into the lens, a tiny fragment falling from the lips, a first breath disturbing suspended bone-white (#F5F2EB) dust. A shoulder fractures and a heavy slab drops to the floor, intact charcoal fabric beneath a fading gold seam. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

segments.text: He removes what conceals it. The expectations. The performances. The identities you inherited without choosing.
segments.visual_prompt: Continuous push-in on one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), now cracking without any visible strike. A fracture travels across the chest and stone separates along its own weakness in a slow bloom of ivory dust. A section falls from the upper back, then the jaw: human lips emerge and the figure inhales. Granite slides off both shoulders, revealing intact charcoal fabric; muted gold (#C6A94F) lights the fracture edges, then fades. Silhouette now unmistakably human. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

segments.text: Not everything you carry belongs to you. And not everything you lose is a loss.
segments.visual_prompt: Close on the hand of one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers holding a rough charcoal-black (#1A1A1A) stone fragment. The fingers deliberately open and release it; the fragment strikes the black floor in silence. Cut to the ankles: the last granite collars crack and fall, dark shoes settle onto the stone floor below intact trouser cuffs, ivory dust drifting down. Camera begins a slow, restrained rise. First act of choice, not force. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

segments.text: Some things have to fall away before you can finally become...
segments.visual_prompt: Head-and-shoulders portrait of one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers: natural facial features, subtle asymmetry, residual ivory (#F5F2EB) stone dust on intact clothing, granite rubble beside their dark shoes in the gallery. They take one quiet breath, look directly into the lens without smiling, and take exactly one deliberate step toward camera. The narrow ivory light beam narrows toward darkness, matching the opening frame. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

final_segment_override.note: Final word trails into silence. Grammatically unresolved, inviting loop restart. Ellipsis drives the TTS decay.

sound_brief.emotional_temperature: cold, mechanical, inevitable. Not triumphant, not inspirational.
